sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Regional Growth NSW Development Corporation (RGDC) is seeking submissions from suitably qualified and experienced organisations for the engagement of a Principal Contractor to undertake the construction of the augmentation / upgrade to the existing Jindabyne Wastewater Treatment Plant.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The scope of services includes the construction of the augmentation / upgrade the existing Jindabyne Wastewater Treatment Plant from 8,000 (equivalent persons) EP to 16,000 EP (with provision for future expansion to 24,000 EP) capacity to meet the increased demands associated with the development of the Snowy Mountains Special Activation Precinct and the Jindabyne area.
It is noted that the Jindabyne Wastewater Treatment Plant must remain operational during the augmentation / upgrade construction works.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
This RFT process is being managed under the Two-Envelope system. Refer to the section Opportunity Requirements for the details.
A non-mandatory Pre-tender meeting is proposed. Refer to the Opportunity Requirement for the details.
Notifications
To receive notifications about this opportunity (addenda, notices etc.), suppliers must either save the opportunity to their dashboard or have started a draft response.
Lodging a Response
You must lodge your tender via the buy NSW Tenders platform, in accordance with the Conditions of Tendering. You must not submit your tender via email. Late submissionsare unable to be accepted, so we suggest uploading your submission earlier in the day, as you may experience delays and disallowed files. Click the RESPOND button to submit your electronic tender response. Suppliers must submit their response into the buy NSW system before 3pm on the close date. Responses can be submitted and edited multiple times until the opportunity closes, with only the most recent submission being submitted.
buy NSW Tenders Help
If you experience any technical difficulties submitting your tender, please contact the buy NSW team at buy.nsw@customerservice.nsw.gov.au or 1800 679 289.
